shortDescription: MPESB Group 3 Sub Engineer & Other Post Online Form 2026. See the official notice at esb.mp.gov.in.
content:
Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board is accepting (or has reopened) online applications for Group-3 Sub Engineer and other posts.

Read the detailed advertisement for eligibility, fee, dates and district/post-wise vacancies before you submit the form.

How to apply

  1. Open esb.mp.gov.in
  2. Complete registration / OTR if required
  3. Fill the form, upload documents and pay the fee
  4. Print the confirmation page
